en: Vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground is an open grassy field bordered by a road with trees and a few pedestrians. Behind it stand farm buildings and multi‑storey houses with traditional German architecture, and further up the slope are scattered villas and houses leading toward a wooded hill in the background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image, along with a publisher line and number.
